text: Thank you for waiting. The archive has returned <returned_count> records; <unavailable_count> remain unavailable. Review the available records or retry the unavailable ones.
note: Requires exact returned and unavailable counts; retry must be supported.
originalText: Thank you for waiting. The archive has returned <returned_count> records; <unavailable_count> remain unavailable. Review the available records or retry the unavailable ones.

text: You may leave this page while <operation> runs. Its current status is <status>; return to Activity to review it.
note: Requires a persistent activity record and truthful status value.
originalText: You may leave this page while <operation> runs. Its current status is <status>; return to Activity to review it.

text: We found a difference between your version and the saved version. Compare them before choosing which changes to keep.
note: Requires both versions to remain available for comparison.
originalText: We found a difference between your version and the saved version. Compare them before choosing which changes to keep.

text: There is no reliable wait estimate yet. You can stay here, or return to <status_location> later to check the queue.

text: The request is ready, but it will include <scope>. Please review that scope before selecting Continue.

text: Thank you for your patience. <completed_count> items are complete; <pending_count> still need attention. Open the list to review the pending items.

text: We cannot verify that the cancellation took effect. Check <activity_location> for its status before submitting the request again.

text: Your choice to skip <optional_step> is recorded. Continue to <next_step> when you are ready.

text: The import stopped at row <row_number> because <reason>. Correct that row, then upload the file again.

originalText: The import stopped at row <row_number> because <reason>. Correct that row, then upload the file again.

originalText: I appear to have mistaken a promising beginning for an actual accomplishment. <operation> stopped at <stage> because <cause>. Please <next_step>.
